review_scope: Read-only scientific and recovery design audit; no queue launch, GPU operation, host process inspection or runtime/output mutation performed

resume_assessment.checkpoint_contents: Only completed-task LoRA A/B factors, metadata and classifier tensors/state. Partial current-task model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG/dataloader state not saved.
resume_assessment.task_boundary_resume: Underlying src/trainer.py has resume_from_task and baseLoRA.load_task_checkpoint for forked trajectories, but this requires config change and does not restore consumed RNG or full scientific audit trace. Current immutable native/run.py exposes no resume option and enforces fresh empty output.
resume_assessment.recommended: Archive partial attempts and restart these same three jobs from initialization, original configs and seeds. Preserve six completed formal and sixty completed smoke jobs as canonical evidence.

requirements: Verify controller and worker PID/starttime identities are dead in true host namespace; obtain original controller.lock exclusively before archive/reset; check children/GPU processes too.
Preserve original controller.lock inode: never unlink or replace it. Snapshot controller.json, queue_state.json and controller.log (and existing launch/error records) with hashes.
Move exactly three partial runtime/jobs/<job> and outputs/<job> trees to unique attempt archive with hash/size file index, then verify hashes; leave active locations absent for exclusive creation.

Reset exactly three interrupted state entries to pending; preserve 66 completed entries and all51 previouslypending entries byte-equivalent JSON values. Record attempt metadata outside pinned suite/code/configs.

Leave RUN_PINS.json, suite.json, configs, original scientific code, completed.json receipts, completed output and audit traces unchanged. Revalidate completed summaries/smokes using original validator. Validation reports may be rewritten by original controller but scientific evidence/receipts must not change.

Run original run_queue.py unchanged in same host/Python environment as new isolated background controller. Keep allowed GPUs [4,5,6], max3 and UUID/index flock safeguards. Preserve same-seed N03→N14 Gmatch dependency.
Release recovery controller lock before starting original controller, which must reacquire nonblocking exclusive lock. If race occurs it safelyfails; do not bypass lock or launch secondcontroller.
Verify new three jobs receive fresh worker identities, correctGPU UUIDs and finite epoch loss, then record recovery receipt.
caveats: Do not merely restart existing queue_state: stale running workers have no exit.json and would be marked failed, causing fail-closed halt.

Restarting original controller re-runs per-completed-job validator and rewrites validation.json/validation.console.log. Preserve those old validation reports in an archive if literal all-file immutability is desired; final summaries, checkpoints, direction traces, completed receipts remain authoritative and untouched.

checks: Exact pre-state/pin/source identity verified before applying under original controller.lock
